settings.heading: A curated store for travel, leisure and sleep.
settings.text: WEDRA is an online retailer. We bring together essentials from different brands and makers — for packing, resting and slowing down — and present them in one considered place.

settings.heading: We choose. The makers make.
settings.text:
WEDRA doesn't put its name on other companies' products. When a product has a brand, you'll see that brand on its page; when it doesn't, we say so.

What we add is the selection: fewer, better options for the way you travel and rest.

settings.title: Useful
settings.text: Every product has to earn its place in a bag or beside the bed.

settings.title: Considered
settings.text: We look for thoughtful design and materials, whoever makes it.

settings.title: Comfortable
settings.text: Chosen for how it feels at the end of a long day of travel.

settings.heading: A collection that grows with care.
settings.text: New products and brands join WEDRA when they fit — not to fill a catalogue. Subscribe to hear when something new arrives.

settings.heading: New arrivals, occasionally.
settings.text: New products and brands as they join WEDRA. Nothing more.
